title: @Operation Mincemeat Broadway has been one of my favorite musicals si...
transcript: I was already so excited to see the new Broadway cast of Operation Mincemeat. Truly, one of my favourite things is seeing a new actor in a role I love. But I was not prepared for how different this new cast would make the show feel in the best way. This is the first all American cast that Operation Men's Meat has had, this is the first time I've seen the show without the original cast. I've seen a couple of understudies, but I've always had at least, like, four original cast members on. And what I really loved was that this cast was not trying to recreate the original one. It was a whole new group of actors getting to play, play and bring their own personalities into it. They made different choices, they found new rhythms in the comedy. Jokes that I've heard many times before just hit complete differently, and there are moments that I laughed harder than I ever have. And it kind of felt like I was seeing the show for the very first time again. The chemistry between the five of them was just so good. You can tell they trust each other and they're having fun, and that joy just radiates throughout the entire higher theater. Brandon, Jesse and Amanda have all been with the show since the beginning as understudies, and now that they're the principal cast, you can tell how well they know their characters and all their choices feel So specific. And then Julia comes in with this glorious, chaotic, goofy energy. She's so charismatic and so charming. And Jeff is just glorious. I can't get over that. I saw him as the Phantom of the opera six months ago. He was so good. And for him to nail that but then also be able to do the humor of Spillsbury and Willy Watkins and then break your heart as Hester. The range is insane. And then he's also just so nice because he invited Ben and I to come on stage. I'm such a theater nerd. This was so thrilling. Thank you, Jeff. But anyway, if you love Operation Men's Meat or you haven't seen it yet, now is the time to go back. You have to see this cast.
